::: {#cor-homoskedastic-deviations}
#### Deviations in a homoskedastic model

In a homoskedastic model (@def-homoskedastic),
the deviations (@def-slr-deviation) all have the same variance $\sigma^2$:

$$\cdev_i \mid X_i = x_i \simind \ndist{0, \sigma^2}.$$
:::

::: proof
By @thm-slr-additive, $\cdev_i \mid X_i = x_i \simind \ndist{0, \sigma_i^2}$,
and @def-homoskedastic sets $\sigma_i^2 = \sigma^2$ for all $i$.
:::
